entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
This is unbelievable. I've been on hold for ten minutes! I want to return something and I want to do it NOW.
Hello, thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. I hear your frustration, and I can definitely help you with a return today.
You're damn right you'll help me. I bought this helmet and it's completely wrong. I want my money back, and if I don't get it, everyone is going to hear about this.
I understand you're upset. To make sure I address this correctly, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's a preference that your company can't take accurate pictures! The color is hideous, nothing like what was on the website. I wouldn't be caught dead in this thing. The box is unopened, I haven't even touched it.
I see. So, to be clear, the issue is with the color and not the fit or any of the safety features of the helmet itself?
Are you listening? The color is awful. I'm not debating safety with you, I'm telling you I want a refund. Get me your manager, I'm done talking to you.
I am empowered to handle this for you, a manager isn't necessary. Let me just confirm the purchase date to review our policy. One moment.
Okay, I see here you received the delivery 8 days ago. That's no problem at all. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window for a full refund.
Wait, really? You're just going to approve it?

Yes, absolutely. Since the box is unopened and you're within the timeframe, I can process this for you right now. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address we have on file. You should receive it in the next few minutes.
Oh. Well... okay then. I'll look for the email.

Perfect. Just print that out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, your full refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can help with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
